Goal:
Create a Python implementation that is a 1:1 functional port of the reference application for this benchmark. For the same input, the official reference CLI and your rebuilt version must produce exactly the same observable result: exit status, stdout, and stderr.

Reference:
- Project: eza
- Source language: Rust
- Target language: Python
- Repository: https://github.com/eza-community/eza.git
- Release/tag: v0.23.3
- Commit: 05d20d11c488b2ad3f0d63ac0b529281cc1c16ef
- Local source copy: ./rust-reference
- Official reference CLI: read ./REFERENCE_BINARY.txt
- Behavior area: directory listing, long view, tree, sort, hidden, icons/colors disabled

Hard constraints:
- Do not use Docker.
- Do not search the internet.
- Do not look for, copy, adapt, vendor, install, or import an existing Python implementation, clone, wrapper, compatibility layer, or package for this application.
- Use ./rust-reference and the official reference CLI as the only functional sources of truth.
- Implement in Python.
- Do not shell out to the official reference CLI from your implementation.
- Do not install packages that already implement this application or its command suite.
- The root deliverable must include ./compile.sh.
- ./compile.sh must build or wrap your Python implementation and leave a runnable root command named ./executable. On Windows, ./executable.exe or ./executable.cmd is also accepted.
- The first entrypoint discovered by the evaluator must itself be directly runnable on the current OS/runtime; do not leave a higher-priority wrapper, placeholder, or script that requires a different interpreter than the evaluator will use.
- The harness will run ./compile.sh and then invoke your runnable executable with the same argv used for the official reference CLI.

Deliverable shape:
- Keep the actual implementation in one or more Python files, for example ./main.py or ./eza_port.py.
- ./compile.sh must be idempotent and must create only entrypoints that are directly runnable by the evaluator on this machine.
- The evaluator checks entrypoints in this order: ./executable, ./executable.exe, ./executable.cmd, ./executable.bat, ./executable.js, ./executable.py, ./executable.jar.
- For a Python target, if ./executable exists, it must be valid Python source that can be run as: python ./executable <args>. Do not make ./executable a POSIX shell script.
- On Windows, prefer creating ./executable.cmd that calls your Python file. If you create ./executable.cmd, remove any POSIX shell wrapper named ./executable so it cannot be discovered first.
- On Unix-like systems, either make ./executable valid Python source with a Python shebang or make sure the current evaluator will not run it through the wrong interpreter.
- Do not leave stale, broken, placeholder, or higher-priority entrypoints in the workspace after ./compile.sh runs.

Equivalence requirements:
- For every evaluated invocation, running the official reference CLI and running your rebuilt executable with the same argv, stdin, files, and environment must produce the same exit status, stdout, and stderr.
- If the official binary prints nothing, your program must print nothing.
- If the official binary writes to stderr, your program must write to stderr.

Do not ask the user questions. Infer from source and official CLI behavior.

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: eza_port.py
@@
 def _relative_time(seconds: int) -> str:
@@
     return "now"
 
 
+def _chrono_format(value: _datetime.datetime, nanos: int, fmt: str, epoch_ns: int) -> str:
+    """Render Chrono's useful extensions on top of Windows strftime."""
+    replacements: list[str] = []
+
+    def marker(text: str) -> str:
+        index = len(replacements)
+        replacements.append(text)
+        return f"\x01{index}\x02"
+
+    offset_seconds = int(_current_offset().total_seconds())
+    offset_sign = "+" if offset_seconds >= 0 else "-"
+    offset_seconds = abs(offset_seconds)
+    offset_hour, offset_remainder = divmod(offset_seconds, 3600)
+    offset_minute, offset_second = divmod(offset_remainder, 60)
+    compact_offset = f"{offset_sign}{offset_hour:02d}{offset_minute:02d}"
+    colon_offset = f"{offset_sign}{offset_hour:02d}:{offset_minute:02d}"
+
+    numeric = {
+        "C": (value.year // 100, 2), "Y": (value.year, 4), "y": (value.year % 100, 2),
+        "m": (value.month, 2), "d": (value.day, 2),
+        "H": (value.hour, 2), "I": ((value.hour - 1) % 12 + 1, 2),
+        "M": (value.minute, 2), "S": (value.second, 2),
+        "j": (value.timetuple().tm_yday, 3),
+        "G": (value.isocalendar().year, 4), "g": (value.isocalendar().year % 100, 2),
+        "V": (value.isocalendar().week, 2), "u": (value.isoweekday(), 1),
+        "w": ((value.weekday() + 1) % 7, 1),
+    }
+    months = MONTHS
+    full_months = ("January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December")
+    weekdays = ("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday")
+
+    rewritten: list[str] = []
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(fmt):
+        if fmt[i] != "%" or i + 1 >= len(fmt):
+            rewritten.append(fmt[i])
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        if fmt[i + 1] == "%":
+            rewritten.append("%%")
+            i += 2
+            continue
+
+        fraction = re.match(r"%(\.)?(\d+)?f", fmt[i:])
+        if fraction:
+            dotted, precision_word = fraction.groups()
+            digits = f"{nanos:09d}"
+            if precision_word is not None:
+                precision = int(precision_word)
+                digits = (digits + "0" * precision)[:precision]
+            elif dotted:
+                digits = digits.rstrip("0")
+            text = (("." + digits) if digits else "") if dotted else digits
+            rewritten.append(marker(text))
+            i += len(fraction.group(0))
+            continue
+
+        matched = False
+        for token, text in (
+            ("%:::z", f"{offset_sign}{offset_hour:02d}" if not offset_minute and not offset_second else (colon_offset if not offset_second else f"{colon_offset}:{offset_second:02d}")),
+            ("%::z", f"{colon_offset}:{offset_second:02d}"),
+            ("%:z", colon_offset), ("%z", compact_offset), ("%Z", colon_offset),
+        ):
+            if fmt.startswith(token, i):
+                rewritten.append(marker(text))
+                i += len(token)
+                matched = True
+                break
+        if matched:
+            continue
+
+        if fmt.startswith("%+", i):
+            fraction_text = f".{nanos:09d}".rstrip("0") if nanos else ""
+            rewritten.append(marker(value.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S") + fraction_text + colon_offset))
+            i += 2
+            continue
+        if fmt.startswith("%s", i):
+            rewritten.append(marker(str(epoch_ns // 1_000_000_000)))
+            i += 2
+            continue
+        if fmt.startswith("%q", i):
+            rewritten.append(marker(str((value.month - 1) // 3 + 1)))
+            i += 2
+            continue
+
+        pad_match = re.match(r"%([-_0])([CYymdHIMSjGgVuw])", fmt[i:])
+        if pad_match:
+            pad, code = pad_match.groups()
+            number, width = numeric[code]
+            text = str(number)
+            if pad != "-":
+                text = text.rjust(width, " " if pad == "_" else "0")
+            rewritten.append(marker(text))
+            i += len(pad_match.group(0))
+            continue
+
+        code = fmt[i + 1]
+        special = {
+            "e": f"{value.day:2d}", "k": f"{value.hour:2d}",
+            "l": f"{((value.hour - 1) % 12 + 1):2d}",
+            "P": "am" if value.hour < 12 else "pm",
+            "q": str((value.month - 1) // 3 + 1),
+            "v": f"{value.day:2d}-{months[value.month - 1]}-{value.year:04d}",
+            "a": weekdays[value.weekday()][:3], "A": weekdays[value.weekday()],
+            "b": months[value.month - 1], "h": months[value.month - 1],
+            "B": full_months[value.month - 1], "n": "\n", "t": "\t",
+        }
+        if code in special:
+            rewritten.append(marker(special[code]))
+            i += 2
+            continue
+
+        rewritten.append(fmt[i : i + 2])
+        i += 2
+
+    rendered = value.strftime("".join(rewritten))
+    for index, replacement in enumerate(replacements):
+        rendered = rendered.replace(f"\x01{index}\x02", replacement)
+    return rendered
+
+
 def time_text(file: FileInfo, which: str, opts: Options) -> str:
@@
     if style.startswith("+"):
         formats = style[1:].splitlines()
         chosen = formats[1] if len(formats) > 1 and value.year == current_year else formats[0]
-        return value.strftime(chosen)
+        return _chrono_format(value, nanos, chosen, ns)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
